note: Counted by morpheme: prefixes (and, the, in, to, like, from …) and pronoun suffixes are counted on their own (morphemes), never as part of the word they attach to; words are the remaining parts, by dictionary form (key; split by Strong's number for the homographs in splits). All Hebrew NFC. Hebrew words counted: 300807; morphemes: 461701.
